AnswerSSE.description: Activate the EduTutor service. This API is in public preview. Each account can invoke it up to 1,000 times per day for free.
AnswerSSE.responseParamsDescription:
### Algorithm result field data
+ Serialization is required. The field descriptions are as follows:

| Name | Type | Description | Example Value |
|-----|------|-----|-------|
| message | array |  |  |
| message[0].content | array |  |  |
| message[0].content[0].text | string | Large Language Model (LLM) problem-solving result. | "### 【Analysis】:\
Core knowledge points covered in this question include simplification of algebraic expressions..." |
| message[0].role | string | Role. | "assistant" |

Example:
```
{
  "message": {
      "content": [
          {
              "text": "### 【Analysis】:\
Core knowledge points covered in this question include simplification of algebraic expressions and substitution-based evaluation. The problem provides two conditions: \\(a + b = -1\\) and \\(ab = 4\\), and asks us to evaluate the expression \\((4a - 5b - 3ab) - (3a - 6b + ab)\\). This type of question commonly appears in basic algebra sections, testing students' grasp of fundamental algebraic operations and substitution methods.\
\
### 【Method Guidance】:\
1. **Simplify the expression**: First, simplify the given expression by combining like terms.\
2. **Substitute known conditions**: Substitute \\(a + b = -1\\) and \\(ab = 4\\) into the simplified expression for calculation.\
3. **Step-by-step solution**: Obtain the final result through sequential substitution and computation.\
\
### 【Detailed Solution】:\
\
#### Step 1: Simplify the expression\
The expression is \\((4a - 5b - 3ab) - (3a - 6b + ab)\\).\
\
Remove parentheses and combine like terms:\
\\[\
(4a - 5b - 3ab) - (3a - 6b + ab) = 4a - 5b - 3ab - 3a + 6b - ab\
\\]\
\
Combine like terms:\
\\[\
= (4a - 3a) + (-5b + 6b) + (-3ab - ab) = a + b - 4ab\
\\]\
\
#### Step 2: Substitute known conditions\
Using the given conditions \\(a + b = -1\\) and \\(ab = 4\\), substitute these values into the simplified expression:\
\\[\
a + b - 4ab = -1 - 4 \\	imes 4 = -1 - 16 = -17\
\\]\
\
#### Step 3: Final result\
Thus, the value of the expression is \\(-17\\).\
\
### 【Final Answer】:\
\\(\\boxed{-17}\\) \
\
The value of the expression is \\(\\boxed{-17}\\)."
          }
      ],
      "role": "assistant"
  }
}
```

CutQuestions.description: Activate the EduTutor service. This API is in public preview, and each account can invoke it up to 1,000 times per day for free.
CutQuestions.responseParamsDescription:
#### Algorithm result field data  
+ Must be serialized. The field descriptions are as follows:

| Field | Type | Description | Example Value |
|-------|------|-------------|---------------|
| questions | array | Array of questions segmented by the model. | |
| questions[i].pos_list | array | Coordinate boxes of the i-th question (may contain multiple boxes). | [[21,0,364,0,364,82,21,82]] |
| questions[i].sub_images | array | Links to sub-images extracted based on coordinate boxes (valid for 7 days). | |
| questions[i].merged_image | string | Link to the complete image of the question after merging all sub-images (valid for 7 days). | |
| questions[i].info | object | Structured information of the question. | |
| questions[i].info.type | string | Question type: multiple choice / fill-in-the-blank / true-or-false / Q&A pair / essay / other. | Fill-in-the-blank |
| questions[i].info.stem | array | Stem information of the question. | |
| questions[i].info.stem.text | string | Text of the question stem. | |
| questions[i].info.stem.pos_list | array | Coordinate box information of the question stem. | |
| questions[i].info.option | array | Option information. | |
| questions[i].info.option[j].text | string | Text of the option. | |
| questions[i].info.option[j].pos_list | array | Position information of the option. | |
| questions[i].info.figure | array | Illustration information. | |
| questions[i].info.figure[k].pos_list | array | Position information of the illustration. | |
| questions[i].info.answer | array | Answer information. | |
| questions[i].info.answer[m].pos_list | array | Position information of the answer. | "-17" |
| questions[i].info.answer[m].text | string | Text of the answer. | |
| questions[i].info.subquestion | array | Sub-question information (structure consistent with info). | |
